secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app ID — identifies this app's backend on the Base44 platform. Found in the Base44 dashboard under your app's settings.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base44 backend base URL that the Vite dev server proxies /api requests to (e.g. https://api.base44.com or your app's Base44 backend URL). Found in the Base44 dashboard / app settings.
